author: Subscriptor
body:
Thanks for getting me to 50 subscribers, let's keep going.
I have not made any parts of the pack, I just edited quite a few stuff and mixed some packs together. 
Most of the pack is 16x (default) so it is not supposed to cause any lag. 

Features:

  • Clear water
  • Low fire
  • Purple fire
  • Shadows on armor (looks really cool q:^])
  • Cool 16x swords
  • Default (16x)
  • Clear GUIs
  • Bow pulling colors
  • LagFree!
  • Nice block theme (check out yourself!)
  • Big particles

Showcase video:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0iCWp-nL5A0&feature=youtu.be
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/f664qh8j878buw7/50+subs+pack+-+ThatIsReallyHot.zip
I hope you like the pack and enjoyed the video, please subscribe for more! (I recently found good render settings so I will start uploading quite frequently.)
